newsitem.title: UK: Britain's queen heads off for Thailand visit.
newsitem.headline: Britain's queen heads off for Thailand visit.

text.p: Queen Elizabeth, accompanied by her husband Prince Philip and British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind, left London on Sunday for a state visit to Thailand.
The five-day visit will be the queen's first to the Asian country since 1972.
It is timed to celebrate the 50th anniversary of King Bhumibol Adulyadej's accession to the throne and to strengthen already close ties between the Thai and the British royal families.
Bhumipol, 68, is the world's longest serving monarch.
